title: Physical Constants Calculator
prompt: Which source is designed to provide physical constants and unit conversion factors?
objective: Demonstrate scipy.constants through a focused scientific-computing task, then verify the result.

starter.instructions: Select one option and justify why the alternatives do not fit the stated task.

expected_output: Correct selection: scipy.constants. Add a short explanation of the method choice and its assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Use the relevant API or concept: scipy.constants.
Use a small deterministic synthetic input and document its units/shape/domain where relevant.
Validate the computed output with an appropriate assertion, residual, tolerance, or diagnostic.
Explain one limitation or assumption of the selected method.
hints: Translate the prompt into input, operation, expected behavior, and an independent check.
Look up the documented signature for scipy.constants; inspect status and error information where available.
Test one boundary or invalid input before considering the work complete.

retry_policy: Allow retries. Incorrect or incomplete attempts do not complete the activity; repeated correct submissions must not produce additional activity rewards.
